The BiWaze® platform

Two market-leading systems, one respiratory story.

Differentiated airway clearance and cough assist for the patients who need it most.

Cough Assist (MI-E)

BiWaze® Cough System

BiWaze® Cough is an advanced cough assist system that helps clear mucus from your lungs when your body can’t do it on its own. It uses gentle air pressure to simulate a natural cough—making it easier to breathe and reduce the risk of lung infections. Designed for both home and clinical use, BiWaze Cough helps maintain healthy lung volume during therapy with a feature called PAP on Pause. The dual-blower system keeps therapy consistent and hygienic, while the easy-to-use interface makes treatment simple and comfortable.

  • Dual airpaths keep inhaled air clean, separated from exhaled mucus.
  • Controlled pressure, gentle oscillation, and up to 10 personalized profiles.
  • Insufflation / exsufflation / pause cough cycle with a touchscreen interface.
  • Lightweight 9 lb system with up to 2 hours of battery and a padded carry case.
View product →
OLE Airway Clearance

BiWaze® Clear System

BiWaze® Clear is designed to clear mucus, open airways and help keep your lungs healthy. What makes this airway clearance therapy different? It delivers Positive Expiratory Pressure (PEP) to help expand your airways. Then, gentle air pulses and vibrations work together to mobilize mucus out of your lungs. During the session, aerosol therapy can be delivered to help loosen mucus and improve clearance. In addition, it provides steady, accurate pressure to support consistent airway opening. The system is designed to reduce the spread of aerosol particles outside the closed circuit—helping protect both you and those around you.

  • Positive Expiratory Pressure (PEP) + High-Frequency Oscillation (HFO) + aerosol.
  • Integrated Aerogen® Solo nebulizer with a closed dual-lumen breathing circuit.
  • Up to 4.5× more aerosol during PEP and 8.5× less fugitive aerosol vs. comparators.
  • 9 lb portable with battery; mouthpiece, mask, and trach adapter interfaces.
View product →
3 therapies. One 10-minute session.

BiWaze® Clear — oscillation, lung expansion, and aerosol in one device.

Instead of stacking separate treatments, BiWaze Clear alternates oscillating lung expansion with high-frequency oscillation while an integrated Aerogen Solo nebulizer delivers continuous aerosol — all through a closed dual-lumen circuit. Independent in-vitro testing showed up to 3× greater expiratory flow bias for mobilizing mucus, with airway pressure held in tolerance across 100% of HFO tests.

  • Positive Expiratory Pressure, high-frequency oscillation, and aerosol in one session.
  • Closed dual-lumen circuit with an expiratory flow bias.
  • Portable 9 lb design that expands airway clearance from hospital to home.
  • For COPD, bronchiectasis, ALS, cystic fibrosis, SMA, and more.

Why the BiWaze platform stands out

Innovation built on respiratory physiology.

ABM re-engineers traditional therapies with technology that improves the standard of care.

Dual-path technology

Separate pathways for inhaled and exhaled air prevent mucus from contaminating the inhalation flow — a key advance over single-path systems.

OLE therapy in one device

BiWaze Clear combines positive expiratory pressure, high-frequency oscillation, and aerosol therapy in a single 10-minute session.

Superior aerosol delivery

In-vitro study: up to 4.5× more aerosol during PEP, 2.2× more during HFO, and 8.5× less fugitive aerosol than a comparator OLE system.

Connected, telehealth-ready

Mobile app and provider portal enable remote control, monitoring, and patient-provider communication.

Portable for home or hospital

9 lb systems with integrated batteries and touchscreens work across acute care and the home.

Education & reimbursement

The ABM Respiratory Care Institute supports training, and HCPCS codes E0469 and A7021 support OLE therapy in the home.

Dealer & clinical FAQ

Common questions about the BiWaze platform.

Who are these systems for?

Patients with compromised airway clearance or an ineffective cough — including neuromuscular conditions (ALS, muscular dystrophy, SMA), spinal cord injury, COPD, bronchiectasis, cystic fibrosis, and tracheostomy or ventilator patients — across hospital and home settings.

What is OLE therapy?

Oscillating Lung Expansion. BiWaze Clear combines positive expiratory pressure, high-frequency oscillation, and continuous aerosol in one 10-minute session to expand the lungs and mobilize secretions.

How is BiWaze Cough different from a standard cough assist?

Its dual-airpath design keeps inhaled air clean and separated from exhaled mucus, and it adds gentle oscillation and supportive pressure between coughs for a more comfortable therapy.

Is there home reimbursement?

Yes. HCPCS code E0469 covers the lung-expansion airway-clearance, continuous high-frequency oscillation, and nebulization device (a 13-month capped rental), and A7021 covers the monthly breathing-circuit kit. See the Coding & Reimbursement link above; HCPS can help you review current pathways.

Is training available?

Yes — the ABM Respiratory Care Institute offers training resources and courses for healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers.
